title: Gafgyt_Botnet_Investigation_6de
description: Investigate unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario. Use the following credentials to access the bot1 host:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Suspicious Service Discovery
levels.content: While monitoring network traffic, you've noticed unusual outbound connections from one of the hosts. Your task is to identify the service responsible for this behavior. Submit the service name as your answer.
levels.solution: Check running services and their network connections. The service name is stored in `/tmp/flag1`.

hints.title: Conceptual Hint
hints.content: Services can be identified by their names and network connections.

hints.title: Directional Hint
hints.content: Check running services and their network connections.

hints.title: Near-Spoiler Hint
hints.content: Use the command `ps aux | grep -i 'suspicious'` to find the service.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (IP Address)
levels.content: Now that you've identified the suspicious service, you need to find out with whom it's communicating. Determine the external IP address that the service is connecting to. Submit the IP address as your answer.
levels.solution: Investigate the network connections of the identified service. The C2 IP address is stored in `/tmp/flag2`.

hints.title: Conceptual Hint
hints.content: Network connections can be investigated using network utilities.

hints.title: Directional Hint
hints.content: Investigate the network connections of the identified service.

hints.title: Near-Spoiler Hint
hints.content: Use the command `netstat -tuln | grep -i '2222'` to find the IP address.

levels.title: Flood Attack Target Identification
levels.content: The unusual traffic patterns suggest a possible flood attack. Determine which system is being targeted by this attack. Submit the IP address as your answer.
levels.solution: Analyze the network traffic patterns and destinations. The victim IP address is stored in `/tmp/flag3`.

hints.title: Conceptual Hint
hints.content: Network traffic patterns can reveal targets of attacks.

hints.title: Directional Hint
hints.content: Analyze the network traffic patterns and destinations.

hints.title: Near-Spoiler Hint
hints.content: Use the command `grep -i 'flood' /var/lib/.botcache/flood.log` to find the target IP address.
